mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_config (name, model_name, endpoint, api_key, max_tokens, temperature, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{modelName}, #{endpoint}, #{apiKey}, #{maxTokens}, #{temperature}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_model_config ORDER BY status DESC, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prompt_template (name, type, content, version, status, variables, sort) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{content}, #{version}, #{status}, #{variables}, #{sort})
